row.notes: Erase, not find, and the key is 16 raw bytes, not a C string: FNV-1a over 16 bytes * seed +0x20, probe ctrl +0x30 (step +0x50, shift +0x54, mask +0x40), slots +0x28 hold node ptrs compared on both qwords. On hit releases node+0x18 obj (vt+0x10), pushes node on free list +8, backward-shift delete, count +0x38 -=1, returns 1; else 0. call sites (Game_SceneManager_DestroyScene, Game_CutsceneModule_Shutdown). Better name: Ne_NameTable_EraseByKey128_Fnv1a (bound record keeps its name).

verify.notes: V8492 hash is FNV-1a over a 16-byte binary key (param_2[0..15]) seeded by +0x20 and compared as two qwords, not a C string; better name Ne_NameTable_FindByKey128_Fnv1a
